observations: Photo 0: silver and black retro style mirrorless camera body; Nikon is printed on the prism housing and Z fc on the top plate, with a Nikon Z mount body cap fitted.
Photo 0: body and grip look clean; the body cap shows light dust and scuffs.
Photo 1: the same body with a black manual focus lens marked TTArtisan, with distance and aperture scales; ISO dial and shutter dial visible, no visible dents.
Photo 2: top view of the body with lens fitted, plus a Nikon rechargeable battery, a Nikon battery charger, a body cap, a rear lens cap and a front lens cap printed TTArtisan APS-C 25mm f2.0.
Not visible: the rear screen, the sensor, the camera switched on, a shutter count, the serial number, the bottom plate, a receipt or warranty card.
All photos carry a Jiji dealer watermark (Oyibest Global Resources).

identity.kind: mirrorless camera with a manual 25mm lens
read_from: photo 0 Nikon on prism and Z fc on top plate
photo 1 Z fc on top plate
photo 2 lens cap TTArtisan APS-C 25mm f2.0

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show Nikon and Z fc printed on the body.
These are the published specs of the Z fc read in photo 0; the sensor itself is not shown.
Top and front look clean in photos 0 to 2, but the rear screen, bottom plate and sensor are not shown and the body cap shows wear.
Internal repair cannot be seen in photos.
No photo or clip of the camera switched on or taking a picture.
No receipt or warranty card is shown.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on, or the shutter, screen or viewfinder may be faulty.
risks.proof: A clip of the camera switching on, taking a shot and playing it back on the rear screen, with a handwritten code and today's date in shot.

risks.risk: High shutter count or heavy use.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count read from a recent photo's file data.

risks.risk: Sensor may be scratched or have dust spots or dead pixels.
risks.proof: A photo of the sensor with the lens off and a test shot of a plain white wall at a small aperture.
risks.if_unproven: as sensor needing cleaning or repair

risks.risk: Rear vari angle screen or its hinge may be cracked or loose.
risks.proof: Photos of the rear screen open and closed, switched on.

risks.risk: Camera may be stolen or a grey import with no valid warranty.
risks.proof: A photo of the serial number on the bottom plate next to the receipt and warranty card showing the same serial.
risks.if_unproven: as no receipt and no warranty

risks.risk: The lens is a third party manual focus TTArtisan, not a Nikon kit lens.
risks.proof: A photo of the lens front showing its full markings.
risks.if_unproven: as body with a low value manual lens

proof_requests: Clip of the camera switching on, taking a shot and playing it back with a handwritten code and today's date in shot.
Shutter count from a recent image file.
Photo of the bottom plate serial next to the receipt and warranty card.
Photos of the rear screen and the sensor with lens off.
Test shot of a plain white wall at a small aperture.
response.reason: Nikon and Z fc are read on the body in photos 0 and 1, with a TTArtisan 25mm f2 lens, battery and charger shown, so it can be priced at worst case as not working with no warranty. A power on and shot clip, shutter count and receipt would raise it.
